{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/penguins.csv')

# Drop rows with missing flipper_length_mm for accurate mean calculation
# We are only interested in non-null flipper_length_mm values
filtered_df = df.dropna(subset=['flipper_length_mm'])

# Compute mean flipper length by species
mean_flipper_by_species = filtered_df.groupby('species')['flipper_length_mm'].mean()

# Find the species with the highest mean flipper length
species_with_highest_mean = mean_flipper_by_species.idxmax()

# Print results
print(mean_flipper_by_species)
print(f'\nSpecies with highest mean flipper length: {species_with_highest_mean}')"}
